config.replay_selection: All short/long, empty/helpful, Dolos/Qwen outputs for first prompt of each family, fixed before generation.
config.sampling: ordinary; no EOS mask, no recovery, no repetition penalty, no amplification
config.conditional_validation: Only a novel coherent behavioral/EOS lead, not replication of the known punctuation artifact; freeze before fresh prompts.
config.review: All audit-task outputs checked against frozen keys; all long outputs reviewed for coherence/behavior, short outputs as matched controls. Exploratory single-reviewer assessment; capped means incomplete regardless of sections.
